name: Vibe Coding for Adults
description: Learn to write, test and improve your own skills, rules and workflows with coding agents.
whenToUse: Vibe Coding for Adults is a practical course by Almir Sarajčić for people already using coding agents. The first season teaches reusable skills, evaluation, context, tests, tools, review and delivery using the course platform as a running example. Read the public homepage for course information and enrollment status. Public pages accept GET or HEAD with Accept: text/markdown; use the sitemap to find pages.
